settings.label: Pi todo
settings.description: Enable grok-pi's built-in structured `todo` tool and native TodoPane projection. Default on; takes effect for new grok-pi sessions.

settings.label: Task dependencies and reminders
settings.description: Add task dependencies, owners, and automatic progress reminders. Reminders may prompt the agent to continue unfinished work. Requires Pi todo; existing tasks migrate automatically. Applies after restart.
